title: Towards Socially and Morally Aware RL agent: Reward Design With LLM
reasoning: The paper focuses on aligning RL agents with human values by using LLMs to provide rewards based on moral and social norms. It specifically evaluates the LLM's understanding of moral values (e.g., comparing the value of a person's life to objects) and social norms (e.g., context-dependent behaviors in public vs. private spaces).
